note: Declarative real-photo sets. A set is a named group of photo directories; photos of the SAME document must stay on the same side of a train/test split (see doc_key in tests/photo_sets.py). The ground truth stays in its own source (10_ocr_research/gt_review_loop.xlsx via gui._gt_map()) -- it is deliberately NOT duplicated here, so the sheet and the sets cannot drift apart.

passport.description: tmp/PassPortPhoto: 44 photos / 40 documents. The passport weight set's own evaluation set (official GT file tests/gt_photo_passport_official.json).

camshots.description: Photo/: 6 camera shots of ONE document (POCHNJIA<<LIMIN). Measures the robustness of a single document to camera angle and lighting -- it is ONE document, not six samples.

passport_union.description: tmp/PassPortPhoto + Photo: 50 photos / 41 documents. The unified 50-photo set. Grouped by document for any train/test split: the six Photo/ shots and the three multi-shot documents in PassPortPhoto must not straddle the split.

pic.description: assets/pic: 64 photos (+3 metadata files: annotations.json, catalog.json, annotations_review.xlsx) / 57 documents. The assets/pic weight set's own evaluation set.

all.description: Every real photo the GUI can list: 50 (passport_union) + 64 (pic) = 114 photos / 98 documents. Cross-distribution -- do not use it to judge one weight set.
